address: 37 Lane 52, Section 1, Meicun Road, West District, Taichung, Taiwan
bio: This casual neo-bistro reimagines familiar Asian flavours and aromas with contemporary flair. Helmed by a team of two chefs and one sommelier, it offers dishes best enjoyed with a carefully curated selection of natural wines and cocktails. Signature dishes such as black tiger shrimp and a Munchi-style Vietnamese pho go particularly well with the natural wines. The interior, reminiscent of a wine cellar, is sleek and modern, with a spacious open kitchen where counter seating adds some theatre to the meal.
